+"""Prepare a release: bump the version and add a release notes header.
+
+Usage: python scripts/prepare_release.py <version>
+
+- Updates `__version__` in `fastapi/__init__.py`.
+- Adds a `## <version>` header below `## Latest Changes` in the release notes,
+  so the existing "Latest Changes" entries become the new release entries.
+"""
+
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+INIT_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^__version__ = \"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\"$", re.MULTILINE)
+SEMVER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$")
+LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER = "## Latest Changes"
+
+
+def bump_version(version: str, init_file: Path = INIT_FILE) -> str:
+    if not SEMVER_PATTERN.match(version):
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid version: {version!r}, expected X.Y.Z")
+    content = init_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    match = VERSION_PATTERN.search(content)
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError(f"No __version__ found in {init_file}")
+    old_version = match.group(1)
+    new_content = content[: match.start()] + f'__version__ = "{version}"' + content[match.end() :]
+    init_file.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
+    return old_version
+
+
+def add_release_header(version: str, notes_file: Path = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE) -> None:
+    lines = notes_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if line.rstrip() == LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER:
+            lines.insert(i + 1, f"\n## {version}\n")
+            notes_file.write_text("".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
+            return
+    raise ValueError(f"No {LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER!r} header found in {notes_file}")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/prepare_release.py <version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    version = sys.argv[1]
+    try:
+        old_version = bump_version(version)
+        add_release_header(version)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        print(f"Error: {e}")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    print(f"Prepared release {version} (was {old_version})")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
